<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex1122023-05-241713" ana="corpusmd:tshad_ma" status="reviewed">
         mtshan nyid la log par rtogs pa spang pa ni | <rs type="person" ref="db:5557" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">slob dpon shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa</rs> dang | <rs type="person" ref="db:5549" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">slob dpon shag kya blo</rs> phyi rol kyi nor bu'i 'od la nang gi nor bur sgro 'dogs pa tshad mar 'dod pa dang | <rs type="person" ref="db:5534" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">slob dpon dul ba'i lha</rs> ni phyed kyi dus su nyin bar bu 'ongs par mthong pa'i rmyi laM kyang shes pa tshad mar 'dod pa dang | <rs type="person" ref="db:5570" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference"><rs type="person" ref="db:3771" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po</rs>'i slob ma kha cig</rs> dang <rs type="person" ref="db:5570" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">mu stegs kha cig</rs> <choice><corr>dung</corr><sic>dang</sic></choice> <lb n="5a4"/> dkar po la ser por 'khrul pa yang dkar po'i mdog dang dbyibs la tshad mar 'dod pa rnaMs spangs pa'o ||||</seg></TEI>
